findings.rule: A functional bore/hole must be defined with a nominal size and tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: D2 provides only '+0.2' with no nominal diameter, while F2 identifies the feature as the inner cylindrical bore. The bore size and fit are therefore undefined.
findings.correction: Add the missing bore nominal diameter and specify an appropriate tolerance or fit class, e.g. Øxx +0.2/0 or an H7 fit, and associate it with F2.

findings.rule: Heat-treatment requirements must be consistent between the title block and notes.
findings.reasoning: The title block heat_treatment field is '---', but note N5 requires the part to be toughened to 24-32 HRC. This creates conflicting manufacturing instructions.
findings.correction: Update the title block heat_treatment field to state the required heat treatment or explicitly reference N5, e.g. 'Toughen 24-32 HRC'.
